messages:
jana: Heads-up: privacy sent a DSAR asking for full erasure for user-789. We located an old encrypted backup blob that likely contains PII. Blob id: backup-2018-07-usr789.blob in s3://cold-archives/2018/backup-2018-07-usr789.blob, encrypted under kms:arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/old-root-001

liam: can you confirm whether the bucket is versioned and if there are any lifecycle rules retaining it?

jana: bucket is versioned, lifecycle keeps archived objects forever (legacy). No active lifecycle policies remove these. Found a GCP copy in gs://coldmirror/2018/backup-2018-07-usr789.blob as well.

claire_sec: TL;DR: we need an auditable deletion path + short-lived RBAC for compliance engineers. Suggest: temporary SAML role with delete permission scoped to that object prefix, TTL 8 hours, approver chain via legal+security.

ops-bot: Reminder: follow deletion runbook v2.1. Required artifacts: manifest (sha256), object versions, CloudTrail event ids, and notarized legal approval.

liam: KMS note: key old-root-001 is in shared legacy keyring. We cannot schedule deletion if other resources reference it. Also key policy disallows external roles from scheduling deletes. We may need to rotate/rewrap backups to a new key first if legal wants immediate erasure.

jana: proposal: 1) Inventory all copies and versions (S3 list-object-versions + GCS metadata). 2) Request legal retention-exception approval to perform deletes. 3) Provision temp role: compliance-temp-delete via ID token OIDC with expiry. 4) Execute delete commands, gather CloudTrail/gs operation ids, produce erasure receipt. 5) If key prevents decrypt/delete, plan key retirement with documented constraints.

claire_sec: RBAC specifics: policy snippet (draft):
```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:DeleteObject","s3:DeleteObjectVersion"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::cold-archives/2018/*"}
  ]
}
```
Attach this only to arn:aws:iam::123456:role/compliance-temp-delete with conditions: aws:TokenIssueTime, aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent, and tag:approved-by=legal-ticket-PRIV-601.

people-ops: we'll accept time-bounded roles but need: approver list, justification blurb, and expiry. Send to approvals@redwood. Also include staging checklist.

liam: for proof-of-deletion, capture: S3 DeleteObject API response + version-id, CloudTrail eventID, S3 inventory (pre-delete) manifest, GCS operation id, and KMS action logs if we schedule key rotation. Also snapshot the object metadata (size, etag) before deletion.

jana: vuln-triage: if the blob contains credentials we should rotate affected keys immediately. We can't decrypt without key access; propose key-owners run a sealed-scan: decrypt into ephemeral environment, run regex/hash scanners, and return a sanitized report (no raw secrets) to security/legal. We must document chain-of-custody.

claire_sec: Note: legal may request a notarized deletion certificate. We'll coordinate to include CloudTrail ids + signed manifest. If key can't be deleted, include explanation and technical mitigation (isolation + rotation plan).

legal-team: please open PRIV-601 and upload proposed artifacts. Legal needs timeline (we have 30 days). If full deletion isn't immediately possible due to key constraints, document the remediation timeline and interim protective measures.

jana: opening PRIV-601 now. I'll attach inventory and ask infra to prepare the compliance-temp-delete role template. pinging @people-ops for fast-track. :rocket:

ops-bot: Action items created: A-987 (inventory), A-988 (role template), A-989 (delete playbook). Assignments: liam->A-987, ops->A-988, jana->A-989.

people-ops: ack. We'll aim to approve the role within 24h once PRIV-601 has justification and approver names.

liam: one more caveat: if we schedule KMS key retirement, the AWS pending window min is 7 days. Legal: is that acceptable or do we need alternative proof?

legal-team: acceptable if documented and paired with deletion artifacts. If key retirement blocks deletion, we require a signed statement and a remediation plan with dates.

jana: thanks all. I'll update PRIV-601 with the playbook, manifest template, RBAC policy, and the required attestations. Will report back once the temp role is approved and inventory complete. :white_check_mark:
